algorithm: Warp-cooperative B-link tree insertion and split/lock/retry traversal followed by warp-cooperative exact key search.
mapping: Native 256-thread blocks, one cooperative warp queue handles up to32 keys; same32-word node layout, flags, side links, root splits and atomic node allocation.

synchronization: Global memory fence on lock acquire/release
Host synchronization after build and search

observation: An ordered-index primitive needs a complete dictionary witness, not only a PASS string. Exhaustive hit/miss queries and every canonical leaf key/value pair distinguish an actual tree from a smoke marker. Tree shape and allocation order are nondeterministic implementation details, so they are inspected separately rather than forced into cross-model byte identity. This named kernel timing does not measure full application indexing overhead.
effort_observation: Shared verification required two host canonicalizer repairs before native five-trial success: include the final leaf pair and exclude the reserved key1 sentinel. CUDA.jl required one semantic signed-ballot-shift runtime repair; three full candidate/check processes include a diagnostic bounds variant of the same defect. KA first process failed a backend namespace lookup before device compilation; second process passed its first device candidate/JIT. JACC passed its first candidate/check. Auxiliary CPU witness initially used the unsaved artifact path, then was corrected to saved_path; an unsaved metadata helper lookup also failed. These shared tool/annotation events remain benchmark effort, not target compiler failures. Prospective windows include same-benchmark evidence bookkeeping.
